Unit 4 Practice Test
This practice test covers Test 4.
1. A cart of mass 2 kg moves at 3 m/s. What is its momentum?
A) 1 kg m/s B) 5 kg m/s C) 6 kg m/s D) 9 kg m/s
2. Impulse equals the change in momentum. True or false?
3. A ball is dropped from a height of 5 m.
(a) Find its speed just before it lands.
(b) Find the time it takes to fall.
pages.2:
4. A spring stretches 0.2 m. (a) Find the spring constant. (b) Find the stored energy.
Q. 1 Explain why a rocket accelerates in empty space.
Ans: momentum of the exhaust balances the rocket's momentum
5. Derive the work-energy theorem from Newton's second law.
